name: omniget
description: Local MCP server that lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI use your own computer and your own logged-in accounts: chats, feeds, browser, files and downloads. Also a downloader for video, music and the courses you bought. Everything stays on your machine. Windows, macOS, Linux.
readmeHtml:
OmniGet

English · Português (Brasil) · Русский · 简体中文

Your coding agent, on your own computer and your own accounts.

A local MCP server that lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini CLI download, convert, read your chats and feeds, and tidy your computer.
Also a downloader for video, music and the courses you bought. Free, open source, and everything stays on your machine.

Follow @tonhowtf on Instagram for OmniGet news and inside news.

This is the original OmniGet. Official builds come only from this repository and getomniget.com; forks with similar names are separate projects.

Connect · Tools · Courses · Manual setup · Safety · Canvas · Downloader · Install · FAQ

Connect in one minute

1. Open OmniGet.

2. Paste this line into Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor or any agent that can run a command:

Connect to OmniGet: run curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:47720/connect" and follow the steps.

3. OmniGet comes to the front with the tool's name and a short code. Check the code and click Allow.

OmniGet writes its server and a private token into that tool's own config. Restart the tool and the OmniGet tools are there. Prefer buttons? Settings → AI & agents → Connect to other apps does the same with one click per tool.

Only on Claude Code? The plugin takes three commands and fetches and transcribes links without the desktop app. The last one installs yt-dlp and FFmpeg if they are missing:

/plugin marketplace add tonhowtf/omniget
/plugin install omniget@omniget
/omniget:setup

Then just ask:

Download this playlist as audio and tell me when every file is done: <url>
Here are 12 links. Queue them, wait, and tell me which failed and why.
Turn this folder into one file I can paste into a prompt, under 50k tokens.
What is using port 3000? Stop it.
Read today's messages in my study group chat and list what I still have to answer.
Download every lesson of this course in order and tell me which ones were skipped: <url>

What your agent can do
Downloads Queue one link or twenty, list formats, wait, pause, retry, read the diagnosis when one fails
Whole sites and courses Drive the built-in browser, read a page within a token budget, download a course in order, write a connector for a new site
Files and media Convert, read finished files, search your book library
Developer tools Folder to one prompt-ready file, page to clean Markdown, a site crawled into files, a pool of rotating proxies, HTTP requests, ports, JSON, JWT, hashes, regex, FTP and SFTP
Chats and feeds Read and reply in your linked chats and social feeds, with your own session
Agents List workspaces, start and follow jobs, read diffs, see pending approvals, drive the Canvas
Memory Recall and teach what the app remembers between sessions
Your computer Scan for junk and plan a cleanup; running it waits for your click

Results come back as structured data, long ones are cut to a limit and saved to a file, and every error says what to do next.

Keep what is yours

OmniGet started as a way to keep the courses people had paid for, and it still does that.

  • Courses you bought. Open the course in the built-in browser, sign in with your own account and tick the lessons. They come down in order, with their subtitles and documents. Run it again later and only what is missing is downloaded.
  • Watch them offline. Video Player turns the folder into a course: subfolders become modules, PDFs and code stay attached to their lesson, and it remembers the lesson you stopped on.
  • Or ask your agent. The same downloader is a set of MCP tools, so download this course in order is one sentence.
  • Your files, your disk. Everything lands in a folder you choose, in formats any player opens. No account, no cloud copy, nothing to renew.
  • Your own session. OmniGet opens only what your login already opens. Lessons with copy protection stay in the list, marked Protected, and are skipped.

Step by step in the Global Downloader guide.

Configure it by hand

The server speaks MCP over HTTP at http://127.0.0.1:47720/mcp. Create a connection in Settings → AI & agents → Connect to other apps → More options to get a token and a ready-made snippet for your tool.

Claude Code 
read -rs OMNIGET_MCP_TOKEN && export OMNIGET_MCP_TOKEN
claude mcp add --transport http --scope project omniget http://127.0.0.1:47720/mcp \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${OMNIGET_MCP_TOKEN}'
Cursor (.cursor/mcp.json) 
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "omniget": {
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:47720/mcp",
      "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" }
    }
  }
}
VS Code (.vscode/mcp.json) 
{
  "servers": {
    "omniget": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:47720/mcp",
      "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" }
    }
  }
}
Codex (~/.codex/config.toml) 
[mcp_servers.omniget]
url = "http://127.0.0.1:47720/mcp"
http_headers = { Authorization = "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" }
Claude Desktop and other stdio-only clients

omniget-mcp ships with every release and bridges stdio to the running app.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "omniget": {
      "command": "omniget-mcp",
      "env": {
        "OMNIGET_MCP_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:47720/mcp",
        "OMNIGET_MCP_TOKEN": "YOUR_TOKEN"
      }
    }
  }
}
It does not connect
  • APP_NOT_RUNNING: open OmniGet and keep the server on in Settings → AI & agents.
  • UNAUTHORIZED or 401: the token is missing or was revoked. Create a connection again and paste the new snippet.
  • A tool is missing: the connection does not have that permission. Tick it under More options.
  • Port in use: OmniGet tries 47720 to 47729; the settings page shows the one in use.

You stay in control

  • Local only. The server listens on 127.0.0.1 and refuses requests from web pages.
  • A token per tool. Each connection has its own token and only the permissions you tick. Revoke one without touching the others.
  • Your click, not the agent's. New connections, cleanups and anything written to your Telegram account wait for you in the OmniGet window. Other messages and posts on your accounts wait too when Ask me first is on; it is off by default. An agent can never approve its own request.
  • Secrets stay put. Cookies, tokens and keys are never returned to an agent.
  • No account, no telemetry about what you download. OmniGet goes online for the sites you ask for, for updates, and for the model provider you configured.

The Canvas

A board where Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode or a local model run side by side in terminals. Draw a cord and two agents can talk. Turn on Lead Mode and one agent recruits and coordinates the others. Usage limits for each account sit on the edge of the screen.

The downloader

Paste a link, pick a quality, press Enter.
Video and audio Own extractors for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, Bilibili, Twitch, Vimeo and more, plus every site yt-dlp supports. Up to 4K, or audio as M4A, MP3, Opus, FLAC, WAV
Galleries Whole galleries and profiles through gallery-dl
Files Magnet links and .torrent, direct links in parallel chunks, HLS streams, live recordings
Telegram Messages, albums, ranges and whole chats with your own account
The queue Resume, retry with backoff, rules per site, followed channels, survives a restart
Browser extension Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox: send a page or its media to OmniGet with your login

yt-dlp, FFmpeg, aria2 and gallery-dl install and update themselves. No Python, no PATH, no terminal.

Tools
Media Music · Video Player · Tube Player · Read · Photos
Download Built-in Browser · Telegram
Create Converter · PDF · Remove Background · Capture · Studio · Dictation
Design Palette · Fonts · Icons · Motion · Board · Components
Social Phone Chats · Server Chats · Short Posts · Photo Feed · Clip Feed · Forums · Pin Boards · Code Hub · Research
Developer DevTools · Repo to Prompt · Scrape · API
System Transfer · System Cleaner

System Cleaner scans, shows a plan, and runs only after you approve. Files go to a quarantine or the Trash, and History undoes it.

Quick tools

Loop sits in your menu bar or tray. One click on the icon opens a small panel: keep the computer awake, clipboard history, saved snippets, a live system monitor, volume per app, and shortcuts to capture, dictation and the cleaner. On Windows, macOS and Linux; each system shows only what works there. With the panel closed, only what you turned on keeps running.

Install

Download from getomniget.com. The page lists the SHA-256 of every file. Updates arrive inside the app.
Windows 10 and 11 Installer .exe, portable .exe, .msi
macOS 10.15+ .dmg for Apple Silicon and Intel
Linux .deb, .rpm, .AppImage for x86_64

On macOS you can also install with Homebrew: brew tap tonhowtf/tap, then brew install --cask omniget.

First launch warnings and antivirus

OmniGet ships without a paid code-signing certificate, so each system asks once.

  • Windows: SmartScreen shows a blue box. Click More info, then Run anyway.

  • macOS: if Gatekeeper says the app is "damaged", move it to Applications and run:

    xattr -cr /Applications/omniget.app
codesign --force --deep --sign - /Applications/omniget.app

  • Linux AppImage: on a libfuse error, run sudo apt install libfuse2 or use the .deb.

  • Antivirus: a few engines flag new unsigned builds by mistake. Compare the file's SHA-256 with SHA256SUMS, then report the false positive to the vendor. Do not turn your antivirus off.

Command line

omniget-cli and omniget-mcp come with every release. Add --json for machine-readable output.

omniget-cli info <url>                        # title, formats and size
omniget-cli download <url> -q 1080 -o ~/Videos
omniget-cli batch links.txt -m 3              # one URL per line, 3 at a time
omniget-cli convert notes.md --to html
omniget-cli usage --watch 60                  # usage limits per account

The claude-plugin/ folder is a Claude Code plugin that fetches and transcribes media from a link, with or without the desktop app.

Build from source

You need Rust (pinned in rust-toolchain.toml), Node.js (see .nvmrc) and pnpm.

pnpm install
pnpm tauri dev

pnpm tauri dev uses its own profile, so it never touches an installed OmniGet. pnpm dev:web opens the interface in a browser with no Rust build. Read CONTRIBUTING.md before sending code.

FAQ

What is OmniGet?

A free, open source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux. Its main part is a local MCP server that gives your coding agent a toolbox for downloads, media, files, your chats and your computer. It is also a downloader on its own: paste a link, get the file, or keep an offline copy of a course you bought.

Is OmniGet free?

Yes. It is licensed under GPL-3.0, needs no account and has no telemetry about what you download.

Which AI agents work with OmniGet?

Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and VS Code connect to the MCP server over HTTP. Claude Desktop and other stdio-only clients use the omniget-mcp adapter that ships with every release. See Connect in one minute.

Can an agent act on my computer without asking me?

Only inside the permissions you ticked for that connection. The server listens on 127.0.0.1 only and each connection has its own token. A new connection, a cleanup and anything written to your Telegram account always wait for your click in the OmniGet window. Other messages and posts on your accounts wait too when Ask me first is on in the connection settings; it is off by default, so turn it on if you grant those permissions. An agent can never approve its own request. See You stay in control.

Do I need to install yt-dlp, FFmpeg or Python?

No. OmniGet installs and updates yt-dlp, FFmpeg and gallery-dl by itself, and checks the hash of each tool before using it.

Which sites can OmniGet download from?

YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, Bilibili, Twitch and Vimeo have their own extractors, and every site yt-dlp supports works too. It also takes galleries through gallery-dl, magnet links and .torrent files, and direct links.

Does OmniGet download online courses?

Yes, the ones your own account can open. Open the course in the built-in browser, sign in and pick the lessons; lessons with copy protection are marked Protected and skipped. See Keep what is yours.

Does OmniGet bypass DRM or paywalls?

No. It downloads what your own session can already open. See Fair use.

Why does Windows or macOS show a warning on first launch?

Each system asks once about an app it has not seen before. Install says what to click, and the download page lists the SHA-256 of every file so you can check yours.

Which OmniGet is the original?

This repository, tonhowtf/omniget, and getomniget.com. Forks are legal under GPL-3.0 and some use similar names; getomniget.com/forks tells them apart.

How can I help?

Read CONTRIBUTING.md and ARCHITECTURE.md, pick a good first issue, or translate the interface in your browser.

More answers in the docs FAQ.

Fair use

OmniGet downloads what your own session can already open. It does not bypass DRM, break paywalls or share credentials. It is meant for personal copies and content you have the right to keep; you are responsible for copyright and each platform's terms. Platform owners: see PLATFORM-OWNERS.md.

Contributing

Contributing guide · Architecture · Governance · Get help · Security policy

Report a problem · Translate · Community · Media kit

Code signing policy

Free code signing provided by SignPath.io, certificate by SignPath Foundation.

  • Authors and approvers: Antonio Leandro. Every release is approved by hand before it is signed.
  • Reviewers: pull requests from contributors are reviewed by the author before they are merged.
  • Signed binaries are built by GitHub Actions from this repository only.
  • Privacy: see the privacy policy. OmniGet sends nothing to other systems unless you ask it to.

Credits

Built on yt-dlp, FFmpeg, gallery-dl, aria2, librqbit, grammers, whisper.cpp, Tauri and Svelte. Full list with licenses in THIRD_PARTY.md.

Loop is OmniGet's mascot. Fan art is welcome; the original artwork may not be used commercially or redistributed modified.

Download OmniGet · getomniget.com · GPL-3.0 · Made by Antonio Leandro

releases.name: OmniGet v1.0.0
releases.body:
## What's new in v1.0.0

OmniGet 1.0 turns the downloader into a desktop full of superpowers: a Global Downloader that grabs media from almost any page, a YouTube client, a book and PDF reader, a media player, Telegram, a canvas where your AI agents work side by side, and a much stronger home for them. Updates now come from getomniget.com.

### New
- **Global Downloader**: open any site in a built-in browser, see every video, audio, subtitle and document the page loads, and download it. Connectors turn a whole course or series page into a folder tree.
- **Tube**: a YouTube client with library, history, mixes, SponsorBlock and DeArrow.
- **Read**: a reader for books, comics and PDFs with a local library.
- **Watch**: a player for movies, shows, courses and live TV, with casting.
- **Music**: a music app for the songs on your computer.
- **Telegram**: download from channels and chats, search, and a built-in SOCKS5 bridge.
- **washmybelly**: cleanup, uninstaller, monitor and optimizer.
- **Agents**: companies of agents with org charts, budgets and approvals; jobs in their own git worktree; review a job's changes hunk by hunk; Arena to compare runs; Codex support; memory that learns fr

releases.name: OmniGet v0.10.1
releases.body:
## Downloads

**Windows**: `.exe` installer or portable.
**macOS**: `.dmg` (Apple Silicon `aarch64` or Intel `x86_64`).
**Linux**: `.AppImage` (universal) or `.deb` (Debian/Ubuntu).

---

### Debian/Ubuntu users — AppImage compatibility

**Debian 12+ ships without FUSE 2 by default**, which AppImage requires.
If `./omniget.AppImage` fails with a libfuse error, run:

```bash
sudo apt install libfuse2
```

…or use `./omniget.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run`.

**Easier alternative**: download the `.deb` instead — works out of the
box on Debian 12+ and Ubuntu 22.04+.

---

### macOS users — "OmniGet is damaged and can't be opened"

The app is not notarized with Apple yet, so Gatekeeper quarantines it.
After moving the app to `/Applications`, run:

```bash
xattr -cr /Applications/omniget.app
```

Then open it normally. If it still refuses, allow it under
**System Settings → Privacy & Security**.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A universal, cross-platform app for downloading media from over 1,800 sites without using the terminal.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: OmniGet is a comprehensive desktop application that simplifies the process of downloading media from over 1,800 different websites, including online course platforms (Udemy, Hotmart, Teachable), YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and various music and book sites. It completely eliminates the need to use command-line tools like yt-dlp, providing a user-friendly graphical interface for tasks that typically require complex terminal commands. By acting as a universal downloader, it consolidates multiple media acquisition workflows into a single, accessible application with multi-language support. It serves as a unified media manager for end-users.
keyFeatures: Massive site support: Capable of downloading courses, video, music, and books from over 1,800 platforms natively.
No terminal required: Provides a fully graphical user interface to completely bypass complex command-line operations.
Universal media handler: Consolidates downloading tools for video, audio, and educational courses into one streamlined app.
Multilingual interface: Supports English, Simplified Chinese, and Russian out of the box with community translation support.
Cross-platform releases: Offers pre-built, free and open-source binaries for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

useCases.title: Archiving online courses
useCases.description: Students use the application to bulk download their purchased Udemy or Teachable courses for offline viewing while traveling.

useCases.title: Social media collection
useCases.description: Users download high-quality videos from TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube directly to their local machines without configuring CLI tools.

useCases.title: E-book acquisition
useCases.description: Readers aggregate books and documents from various supported literary platforms into a single local library.

useCases.title: Non-technical downloading
useCases.description: Users unfamiliar with the terminal utilize the simple GUI to download content that would otherwise require complex yt-dlp commands.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: General users, students, and media hoarders who want a powerful, GUI-based downloader that supports thousands of websites. It is ideal for anyone seeking a centralized, easy-to-use interface instead of dealing with complex CLI commands. The cross-platform nature ensures accessibility regardless of the operating system.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Download the latest release from the GitHub repository.
